name: Project Delivery
description: Scope, schedule, resourcing and stakeholder risks that commonly derail projects.

items.text: Project objectives and success criteria are documented and signed off
items.guidance: Capture measurable outcomes and get sponsor approval before work starts.

items.text: Scope boundaries and explicit exclusions are agreed
items.guidance: List what is out of scope to prevent scope creep later.

items.text: A change control process is defined for scope changes
items.guidance: Define who can approve changes and how impact on time and cost is assessed.

items.text: Requirements are traceable to deliverables and acceptance tests
items.guidance: Maintain a traceability matrix linking each requirement to a test.

items.text: Critical path and key milestones are identified
items.guidance: Highlight tasks with zero float and monitor them weekly.
Avoid single points of failure for specialist skills.

items.text: Schedule contingency is included for high-uncertainty work
items.guidance: Add buffer proportional to uncertainty rather than padding every task.

items.text: External dependencies have owners and agreed delivery dates
items.guidance: Track third-party and cross-team dependencies in the plan.

items.text: Stakeholder map with roles and decision rights is maintained
items.guidance: Use a RACI or similar to clarify who decides, who is consulted.

items.text: Regular status reporting cadence is established
items.guidance: Share progress, risks and decisions needed on a fixed schedule.

items.text: Escalation path for blocked decisions is documented
items.guidance: Define time limits after which issues escalate automatically.

items.text: Budget baseline is approved with a contingency reserve
items.guidance: Hold reserve separately and track drawdown against risks.

items.text: Actual spend is reconciled against forecast monthly
items.guidance: Investigate variances above an agreed threshold.

items.text: Earned value or equivalent performance tracking is in place
items.guidance: Compare planned value, earned value and actual cost.
